query: SELECT n.id FROM central.workflow_nodes n WHERE n.node_timeout_seconds IS NOT NULL AND n.state IN ('ready', 'dispatched', 'running', 'attempt_ambiguous') AND (SELECT MIN(a.claimed_at) FROM central.session_attempts a WHERE a.node_id = n.id) + make_interval(secs => n.node_timeout_seconds) <= $1 ORDER BY n.id
